items.title: Should IBM’s (IBM) OpenAI and Together AI Deals Recast Its Role in Enterprise AI Infrastructure?
items.summary: Earlier this week, International Business Machines Corporation announced a wide-ranging partnership with OpenAI and a multi‑year US$240 million agreement with Together AI to deploy NVIDIA-powered AI infrastructure on IBM Cloud for large‑scale open‑source model inference. By embedding OpenAI’s frontier models directly into IBM Consulting and standing up a dedicated OpenAI Practice, IBM is signaling an intensified push to become a core enterprise AI implementation partner across regulated...
